id: Great Sounds Great Festival 2026-Various Venues - Wellington/Poneke, Wellington -Ticket Master
name: Great Sounds Great Festival 2026
long_description:
One-night multi-venue music festival across Te Aro precinct

Eyegum Music Collective presents GREAT SOUNDS GREAT, a multi-venue music and arts festival taking over Pōneke's Te Aro precinct for one night only on Saturday 5 September 2026. Showcasing 40 of Aotearoa's best artists across 10 neighbouring venues, this is one big party you shouldn't miss.

Eyegum has worked hard to curate a programme that is sure to offer something for everyone, from first time gig-goers to seasoned live music obsessives. The eclectic lineup includes national treasures like Bic Runga and Savage, heavy-hitting legends Beastwars, Kody Nielson’s enigmatic project Silicon, indie math rockers So So Modern, powerhouse party starter Mokotron, local hip hop sensation MĀ, and everything in between.

Tonic Collective are back with an impeccably curated lineup for their travelling stage, which includes Pitch Black celebrating 30 years as Aotearoa electronica pioneers and award winning sonic explorer Amamelia.

It's not all music, three of our best poets Chris Tse, Dani Yourukova, and Jackson McCarthy will also perform.

Excitingly for 2026, we are adding a new venue, the incomparable Meow Nui, helping make this year's event bigger and better than ever. We are also throwing a warm-up party, The Night Before, across three venues in Newtown village on Friday 4 September. This will showcase 12 incredible up-and-coming artists and is the perfect way to prepare for the main event.

Ticket holders will receive a wristband that will give them access to each of the participating venues throughout the event. Information on how to pick up wristbands will be provided to ticket holders closer to the time.

Presented with support from Abandoned Brewery, RadioActive.FM, and Wellington City Council.

Venues: Meow Nui, San Fran, Meow, Valhalla, Rogue & Vagabond, Bedlam & Squalor, Hotel Bristol, St Peter's on Willis, Flying Nun Records, Tonic Travelling Stage.

Lineup: Amamelia, Beastwars, Bic Runga, Bri Louise, Chris Tse, Crook, Cruelly, Dani Yourukova, Deathro (JPN), Dream Chambers, Fazed on a Pony, Groove Council, Hemi Hemingway, Hihi & The Stitchbirds, Hunter Jackson, In Good Company, Jackson McCarthy, JELL, Ludus b2b Rizzo, MĀ, Mauri Aura, mHz, Mokotron, More Blue Noise, Naakz & Babyzoot, Office Dog, Pearly*, Pitch Black, Savage (DJ Set), Savagehine, Sheeps, Silicon, So So Modern, Soft Bait, Tamatha Paul, The Sour, The Spectre Collective: Live-Scored Cinema, Tūi Band, Unsanitary Napkin.

id: Wet Denim Water For Dogs EP Release Tour | Wellington-San Fran, Wellington -Ticket Master
name: Wet Denim Water For Dogs EP Release Tour | Wellington
long_description:
Following the announcement of their forthcoming EP Water For Dogs, Wellington four-piece rock outfit Wet Denim are taking the new music to the stage with a three-date release tour across Aotearoa this September and October.

Water For Dogs, due for release on Thursday 17 September, is shaping up to be Wet Denim’s most ambitious and expansive body of work yet. Singles ‘Living Room’, ‘Silence’ and ‘Mirrors’ have each offered a glimpse into the band’s refreshed rock direction, pushing their sound and their songwriting, all while retaining the energy that defines their live shows.

"We are beyond excited for this tour and to revisit some of our favourite venues around Aotearoa. We are incredibly proud of the new record and are ready to bring you our most high energy run of shows to date" - Wet Denim

Having already revealed some of Water For Dogs to a sold-out crowd at Wellington’s Moon in May and taken the new material to RNZ Afternoons NZ Live, the band are now set to bring the full record to life.




Wet Denim - Live on RNZ - Full Set




Made up of Nick Goodwin, Luca Crampton and brothers Jack and Joe Ledword, Wet Denim have fast become known as a must-see live act within Aotearoa’s music scene. Their last EP On The Line (2024) took them across Aotearoa and Australia and nabbed them support slots with international artists Highly Suspect, The Vanns, The Grogans, Bootleg Rascal, Teenage Dads, The Rions, The Rubens and local legends Blindspott.

Water For Dogs shows the band at their most assured. Don’t miss your chance to see it live in full for the first time this Spring.




Merch is also available for presale with GA tickets, avalible to collect on show day.




San Fran holds a Supervised License. Minors are welcome to attend events at San Fran so long as they are accompanied by a legal guardian at all times whilst at the venue

Join us for a behind-the-scenes tour of Wellington's iconic St James Theatre and The Opera House. Discover hidden stories, architectural splendour, and rich theatrical history as you step behind the velvet curtain and explore two of the city's most beloved performance spaces. Led by expert guides, this tour takes you on a journey through over a century of theatre magic. Tread the boards in the footsteps of legendary performers. Uncover the secrets of stagecraft and marvel at the breathtaking details of these heritage-listed buildings. From opulent foyers and ornate auditoriums to backstage corridors brimming with history, you'll see the theatres as you've never seen them before.
